p5.title: Jalan Berputar
p5.desc: Dengarkan arah bisikan, lalu maju ke tanda yang benar.
p5.hint1: Bisikan selalu datang dari arah yang benar.
p5.hint2: Putar kompas dulu sampai jarum sejajar, baru maju.
p5.hint3: Setelah tiga tanda, putaran itu pecah.
p5.inst1: Pilih Batu Penanda, putar kompas ke utara, lalu maju.
p5.inst2: Bisikan pindah ke timur. Pilih Pohon Tumbang, putar kompas, lalu maju.
p5.inst3: Arah terakhir: Cahaya Lilin ke selatan. Maju saat jarum sejajar.

bisikan.1: Hutan ini terlalu rapi. Pohonnya sama besar, jaraknya sama jauh.
bisikan.2: Bisikan datang dari arah yang benar. Tapi tidak pernah cukup dekat.
bisikan.3: Aku sudah berputar dua kali. Kalau berputar lagi, aku kehabisan napas sebelum malam habis.

pohon.1: Pohon yang sama. Bekas gergaji di batangnya, persis seperti tadi.
pohon.2: Kalau aku berputar lagi, tanah ini akan jadi satu lingkaran yang rapi.

papan.1: Aku mengeluarkan kompas dari saku. Jarinya bergetar, lalu diam.
papan.2: Ada tiga tanda di hutan ini: batu penanda, pohon tumbang, cahaya lilin.
papan.3: Aku harus memilih arah dulu, baru bergerak. Kalau salah, putaran ini belum selesai.

api.1: Udara mendadak hangat. Ujung telingaku terasa perih.
api.2: Di kejauhan ada cahaya jingga bergerak naik turun. Tapi tidak ada asap.
api.3: Api ini tidak membakar. Dia hanya menakuti. Dan malam ini itu cukup.

joy.1: Di depan, sosok berdiri di tengah jalan. Kali ini wajahnya terlihat.
joy.2: Joy. Atau bayangan yang memakai wajah Joy.
joy.3: Dingin di punggungku minta aku lari. Tapi kakiku berat.

lari.1: Aku menunduk dan melewati sosok itu.
lari.2: Dingin menyentuh punggungku sebentar, lalu hilang. Rimba di depan membuka.

maaf.1: Aku berhenti. Kakiku gemetar, tapi tetap di tempat.
maaf.2: Joy, maafkan aku. Aku tahu kau tidak sendirian, dan aku tetap tidak menoleh.
maaf.3: Sosok itu tidak menjawab. Tapi hutan di belakangnya diam, seolah lega.
maaf.4: Dingin itu menyingkir ke samping. Ada jalan di sana.

keluar.1: Aku keluar dari rimba dan berdiri di pinggir kebun warga.
keluar.2: Di arah ladang, langit oranye. Bukan lampu desa.
keluar.3: Aku berjalan ke sana. Kali ini aku tidak berlari.

obj.keluar: Get out of the looping forest
obj.menuju_cahaya: Follow the light toward the field

p5.title: The Looping Path
p5.desc: Listen for the direction of the whisper, then move to the right landmark.
p5.hint1: The whisper always comes from the right direction.
p5.hint2: Turn the compass until the needle lines up, then move.
p5.hint3: After the three landmarks, the loop breaks.
p5.inst1: Pick Marker Stone, turn the compass north, then move.
p5.inst2: The whisper shifts east. Pick Fallen Tree, turn the compass, then move.
p5.inst3: Last direction: Candle Light to the south. Move when the needle aligns.

bisikan.1: This forest is too neat. Every tree is the same size, every gap the same width.
bisikan.2: The whisper comes from the right direction. But never close enough.
bisikan.3: I have gone around twice. If I go around again, I run out of breath before the night ends.

pohon.1: The same tree. The saw marks on its trunk are exactly like before.
pohon.2: If I go around again, this ground will become one clean circle.

papan.1: I take the compass out of my pocket. The needle trembles, then stills.
papan.2: There are three marks in this forest: a marker stone, a fallen tree, a candle light.
papan.3: I must choose a direction before I move. If I am wrong, this loop is not over.

api.1: The air turns warm at once. The tips of my ears start to sting.
api.2: In the distance an orange light rises and falls. But there is no smoke.
api.3: This fire does not burn. It only frightens. And tonight that is enough.

joy.1: Ahead, a figure stands in the middle of the path. This time the face is visible.
joy.2: Joy. Or a shadow wearing Joy's face.
joy.3: The cold at my back tells me to run. But my legs feel heavy.

lari.1: I lower my head and pass the figure.
lari.2: The cold touches my back for a moment, then is gone. The thicket ahead opens.

maaf.1: I stop. My legs shake, but they stay in place.
maaf.2: Joy, forgive me. I knew you were not alone, and I still did not look back.
maaf.3: The figure does not answer. But the forest behind it goes quiet, as if relieved.
maaf.4: The cold steps aside. There is a path there.

keluar.1: I come out of the thicket and stand at the edge of a villager's garden.
keluar.2: Toward the field, the sky is orange. Not from village lamps.
keluar.3: I walk that way. This time I do not run.
